- PR #31972 merged at 2026-11-09T19:44Z through the merge queue (merge commit `80753383a9`). The merged head is `72190560`, the reviewed head: contract review PASS 6748961196 at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, ACCEPT 6748991668. `Fixes` closed this card. This note removes `pm:dispatched`.
- **`collectLookupAutofillErrors` no longer refuses a `lookupAutofill` source on a reference the stack knows only through `objectExtensions`.** A reference resolves only in the `declared` set, the same rule `collectRecordCurrencyPathErrors` got in PR #31956. A reference the stack declares and extends is still judged against the merged fields. Both collectors now build their field map through one private helper, `stackObjectFields`.
- **Nits carried, no card:** the skip is per object, so a source this stack's own extension adds on an extension-only reference is not type-judged either (the card's shape; the save door still refuses a wrong-shaped value). The helper's docblock over-generalises "a pointer INTO an object resolves only a declared one" past the roll-up child lookup; that rides the next touch of `stackObjectFields`.
- No follow-ups owed.
